'''September 2001 Raleigh tournament (South Hills Mall)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in South Hills Mall, Raleigh, NC in September 2001. [[Brad Reinhold]] won it. It is known from Robert Werbicki's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2999">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-27-raleigh-nc-john-waynes-a-bad-mutha-fukad2999/ raleigh-nc-john-waynes-a-bad-mutha-fuka], DeckTech (Robert "Turin" Werbicki, 27 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-27-raleigh-nc-john-waynes-a-bad-mutha-fukad2999/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' September 2001
* '''Site:''' South Hills Mall, Raleigh, NC
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Brad Reinhold]]
